csv_scope_of_work: Marin County Transit District ( Marin Transit or The District ) intends to engage the services of an engineering/consulting firm herein referred to as General Engineering Consultant ( GEC or Consultant ) to provide On-Call General Engineering Services ( GES ). The selected team must possess the planning, evaluating, cost estimating, architectural and design engineering, investigatory, negotiating, socio-environmental, advisory, and operational expertise required to plan, design, develop, implement, operate, and maintain large and small transportation projects. The primary project areas for GES are: Bus Stop Improvements (siting, operations, amenities, ADA accessibility) Bus Transfer Location Improvements Owner s Representative for Facility Design General Engineering Support Construction Management.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: General Engineering Services - Marin County
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary engineering services for Marin Transit transportation and facility improvement projects.
project_scope: On-call general engineering services for Marin County Transit District covering large and small transportation projects. Primary areas include bus stop improvements with siting, operations, amenities, and ADA accessibility; bus transfer location improvements; owner's representative services for facility design; general engineering support; and construction management. The stated total construction cost is 2.0 million USD.
services: On-call general engineering consulting including planning, evaluation, cost estimating, architectural services, design engineering, investigatory and advisory services, operational support, civil engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, landscape architecture, electrical and mechanical engineering, construction/project management, and master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call general engineering services without a clearly defined structure.
- Focus is mainly transportation support, bus stops, transfer locations, and general consulting.
- Includes many disciplines, but structural engineering is only one minor component.
- Contains substantial project management, planning, and owner's representative tasks, which are not core sbp targets.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or architecturally demanding building scope is identified.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. The notice describes an on-call multidisciplinary contract with a 36-month base period and 24-month renewal option, but provides no consultant fee, upset limit, or percentage basis.
references_qualifications: Selected team must demonstrate planning, evaluation, cost estimating, architectural and design engineering, investigatory, negotiating, socio-environmental, advisory, and operational expertise for transportation projects. Disciplines requested include architecture, landscape architecture, civil, geotechnical, structural, electrical, and mechanical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, cost estimating, and planning/master planning.
contracting_authority: Marin County Transit District, San Anselmo, CA, USA. Contact: Javier Peraza. Email: jperaza@marintransit.gov. Phone: 415-226-0870. Website: https://marintransit.bonfirehub.com/opportunities/242778
notes: RFP/RFQ stage. Contract duration is 36 months base period with 24-month renewal option; renewable. Pre-submittal meeting: 07/31/2026 05:00 PM PDT, virtual, attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 07/21/2026 05:00 PM PDT. Funded by FTA. One contract will be awarded. This is an on-call/framework-type procurement and therefore of limited strategic relevance for sbp.
